input.prompt: Original character design sheet for CHOCHLIK, a basic forest enemy in a premium mobile 2D tower-defense game. Create an ORIGINAL woodland imp creature, not resembling any famous goblin or existing game character. Small agile body with bark-like brown skin, patches of moss and leaf clothing grown naturally from the body, long expressive ears shaped like young leaves, slightly oversized hands and feet, mischievous face, asymmetrical twig details. No weapons, no metal armor, no sci-fi. Silhouette must read clearly at very small Android phone scale. Hand-painted/cartoon organic fantasy, warm whimsical tone with a little menace, same visual family as a rooted botanical defender: moss green, bark brown, muted ochre, subtle warm highlights. Clean top-down 3/4 orthographic game-art camera, soft painterly shading, crisp silhouette edges. Professional game studio sprite-source sheet on a simple warm off-white background. Show one large final hero pose plus 5 smaller consistent walk-cycle poses with the same proportions and camera angle: contact, down, passing, up, contact. Add one small hit-reaction pose. No text, no labels, no logo, original IP only.
